plan.rationale: Frozen objective is latency_ms of one complete offline batch=32 FP32 ResNet-18 forward under torch.inference_mode(), bounded by torch.cuda.synchronize() on both sides (resnet_inference.py:41-48), on a single device with distributed_backend null and the communication capability observed not_applicable. The torch collector already ran and is not re-requested: coverage.json shows 59 CUDA kernels with 59/59 associated to project calls, 0 unassociated, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 autograd ranges and 0 backward-associated kernels, so kernel-to-operator attribution is complete. The source runs a plain eager transformers 5.16.1 forward with no CUDA graph capture and a single stream on one device, leaving no overlap, graph-tracing or attribution question that would justify nsys, so it is not selected. Communication-family collectors are unavailable rather than merely unchosen: nccl_tuning has no NCCL communicator or collectives to sample and kernel entry names cannot identify protocol; collective_calibration has no observed collective sizes/dtypes and its synthetic allreduce would not map onto this critical path. device_telemetry is excluded because device-wide NVML PCIe/utilization/memory windows cannot be attributed to the ms-scale timed unit, which contains no host transfer (GPU-resident pixels); no PCIe/NVLink traffic is inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes. The remaining open question for minimizing the synchronized wall window is the host/device split: whether wall time is GPU-busy across the 59 kernel intervals or contains CPU submission and Python dispatch gaps between them, and which host call paths dominate dispatch/binding cost. execution_timeline is selected for its separate plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events and per-device execution intervals; its clock alignment bounds cover matching CPU submissions only (GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown), and it never replaces a communication hook or determines subsequent search actions. python_runtime is selected for a separate warmed cProfile call trace over the same forward path to attribute host dispatch and binding costs (transformers module traversal, torch 2.13.0+cu129); it perturbs execution, so its inclusive/self times are read only as relative host costs, never as clean performance scores or GPU compute durations. binding_cost and candidate_diagnostics are excluded because no candidate exists yet at initial planning. Unavailable dimensions are listed with observed reasons and remain unknown rather than assumed zero.
